{{Quote|Hello! You must be the person that was sent by a 'friend', right?|Devlin|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Devlin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] spokesman who worked for a group of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] union leaders who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] due to dissatisfaction with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] labor laws. While in the Rebel Alliance, he was referred to as [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] Devlin with a rank of [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer I]].
